title: 第21章 洛阳第22章 面见张让
content_zh:
沐云将右手放下后，绕过了星曜石鼎，走到了中间的那一栋建筑当中，这便是＂圣墟＂的城主府。当沐云进到里面，坐上了主位，整个＂圣墟＂的操作面板便出现在了沐云的眼前。
沐云看都没看，只是将身上的资金绝大部分都放了进去，身上只留下了10亿枚金币，100万枚毫金币以及1万枚绿刀币。这些存放在城主府的资金，沐云之后还有大用。
随后，沐云便走到了城主府的后方，那边有着一座微型的传送阵。沐云走进微型传送阵后，便传送到了＂圣墟＂的传送阵这边，传送到了洛阳。
在＂帝望＂中，只有县城等级以上的城市，才能建立传送阵。而从郡城开始，便能在城内建立微型传送阵，提供城内传送的服务。至于州城以上，由于城市的规模太过庞大，甚至还会建立诸多小型传送阵，用以疏导人流。
一般来说，这些小型乃至微型的传送阵，都仅供城市内部传送的功能，对外传送还是必须使用主传送阵。而城市领主可以在城主府进行调控，将这些传送阵设定使用权限，甚至在发生战斗时，临时将这些传送阵关闭。
城主府内部虽然有着专属的微型传送阵供城主使用，但是由于沐云是要前往洛阳，而这个微型传送阵无法直接使用前往，所以沐云才会通过这个传送阵，传送到了主传送阵的位置进行＂换车＂。
大汉帝国，洛阳
沐云来到洛阳的时候才发现，这边的玩家竟然还不少呢。
不过稍微想了一下之后，也就明白了过来，这些玩家都是抱持着＂帝国首都可能会有比较多的机遇和任务＂，＂如果能好运的获得某些原住民ＮＰＣ的赏识，或许就能轻易的飞黄腾达，走在其他玩家的前面＂等等的想法。当然，也有部分玩家，是抱持着掌握情报的目的而来，其中便以大势力的玩家为最。
这时的沐云，其实很想要告诉他们：你们想太多了！
这里是大汉帝国的首都没错。这里是整个帝国权力的中心，也没错。这里有着最多，且最准确的讯息，这也是对的。甚至对于洛阳这边的各种猜测，基本上也都没有错。
可是，这些玩家凭什么认为，他们能接触到任务？能获得机遇？能接触到高层原住民ＮＰＣ？能打听到最新的资讯？
光是看见这些玩家中，绝大部分都是取着诸如＂无敌小霸王＂，＂天下无双＂，＂一剑光寒十九州＂，＂我是你爷爷＂等等的奇葩ＩＤ，沐云就知道他们在这些原住民ＮＰＣ面前绝对讨不了好，还谈什么机遇？单纯的白日作梦罢了！能不被这些原住民ＮＰＣ坑到死都算他走运！
至于为什么沐云能知道这些玩家的ＩＤ？这还用说，因为他有真实之眼阿！
摇了摇头，沐云便径自的离开了。
游戏舱必须是年满18岁的成年人才能购买，而一般的家长并不会让四五岁大的小孩进入游戏。因此，虽然有几位玩家看到了沐云的举动，但是却都误将沐云当作是一个原住民ＮＰＣ，所以并没有人特别的去作关注。
由于沐云接下来要与那些高级原住民ＮＰＣ打交道，不得不去打点自己的仪容。刚好，沐云对于自己身上的这一套新手附赠的麻布装非常的不满，便前往了洛阳的一家布庄。
常有人说：＂佛要金装，人要衣装＂沐云深感认同。
当沐云走出布庄时，原本土里土气的小破孩消失了，取而代之的是一位身穿华服，粉雕玉琢的...小男孩。
换过一身衣服后，沐云便开始朝着洛阳城的某处行走而去。他沿路看着繁华的洛阳城，心中却暗暗叹息着。

大汉帝国屹立于＂帝望＂四百多年，也曾一度衰败过。只是，凭着身为帝国所累积的底蕴，汉室毅然决然的引动帝国气运拨乱反正，造就了汉光武帝的中兴。可是也正因为帝国气运消耗过大，致使大汉帝国的世家们逐渐反客为主，慢慢的的壮大了起来，造成帝国气运的大量流失。
也就是这样，后面才会发生诸如＂党锢之祸＂一系列的事件，而这些事件的发生，使帝国气运进一步的衰败了。帝国气运衰败，导致各种天灾人祸不断的发生。当大汉帝国的汉桓帝和汉灵帝惊觉不妙时，早已为时晚矣。他们开始各种横征暴敛，意图换取宇宙货币，用以填补并稳固气运，却殊不知，正是因为他们的举动，致使帝国气运流失得更快。
＂帝望＂开服满两年后，也就是现实世界中的五个月后，整个＂帝望＂便会开启第一个历史剧情任务，也是唯一一个，可以被准确掌控发生时间的历史剧情任务。在这个历史剧情任务结束之后，各国的历史剧情是否被触发，何时被触发，亦或者整个历史未来被改写，就全凭玩家的努力了。
当然，沐云这一个掌握了＂唯一的未来＂脉络的ＢＵＧ存在，并不算在其中。
到时候，熊国玩家所处的蛮荒古国，将迎来＂奴隶叛乱＂历史剧情，雕国玩家所处的紫罗兰帝国，则迎来名为＂农民起义＂的历史剧情，至于龙国玩家所处的大汉帝国，则将面对＂黄巾之乱＂历史剧情。
当黄巾之乱正式开启后，大汉帝国的气运便会更进一步的加快衰败的速度，直到帝国气运崩解，汉灵帝被气运反噬而亡。自此，大汉帝国气运沦为王国气运，然而王国气运如何能承担得起帝级的洛阳城？最终还是难避董卓的一把火...
蓝星上，除了沐云之外，便仅有那些重生者们知道这部分的剧情，所以这里面有着大把大把的好处。
尽管对于沐云来说，这些好处其实并没有多少可以利用的东西，还要耗费大量的时间，可是他后面还有着沐氏集团的存在阿！这些他看不上眼的东西，对于沐氏集团来说，可不是一丁半点，与其留着被董胖子一把火烧掉，还不如废物利用，最起码，沐氏集团先期的投资都能直接回本了。
不久，沐云的心中便有了些许想法。不过，这些想法都得留待后面才能实施，现在还是正事要紧。沐云走着走着，便来到了一作巨大的府邸，大门上书着：张府。
到地方了！沐云双眼微眯，心道：＂接下来就是飙演技的时刻了。＂
content_en:
After Mu Yun put down his right hand, he bypassed the Xingyao Stone Cauldron and walked to the building in the middle. This is the city lord's palace of the "Holy Ruins". When Mu Yun entered and sat on the main seat, the entire "Holy Ruins" operation panel appeared in front of Mu Yun's eyes.
Mu Yun didn't even look at it, he just put most of his funds in, leaving only 1 billion gold coins, 1 million milli gold coins and 10,000 green knife coins. These funds stored in the city lord's palace will be of great use to Mu Yun in the future.
Afterwards, Mu Yun walked to the back of the City Lord's Mansion, where there was a miniature teleportation array. After Mu Yun walked into the miniature teleportation array, he teleported to the teleportation array of the "Holy Ruins" and teleported to Luoyang.
In "Emperor's Hope", only cities above the county level can build teleportation arrays. Starting from the county town, a micro teleportation array can be established in the city to provide teleportation services within the city. As for the prefectural city and above, because the scale of the city is too large, many small teleportation arrays will even be established to divert the flow of people.
Generally speaking, these small or even micro teleportation arrays are only used for internal teleportation within the city, and the main teleportation array must be used for external transmissions. The city lord can control it in the city lord's palace, set the usage rights of these teleportation arrays, and even temporarily close these teleportation arrays when a battle occurs.
Although there is an exclusive micro teleportation array inside the city lord's palace for the city lord's use, since Mu Yun is going to Luoyang, and this micro teleportation array cannot be used directly, Mu Yun uses this teleportation array to teleport to the location of the main teleportation array to "change cars."
Han Empire, Luoyang
When Mu Yun came to Luoyang, he discovered that there were quite a few players here.
However, after thinking about it for a while, I realized that these players all held the idea that "there may be more opportunities and tasks in the imperial capital", "if they are lucky enough to gain the appreciation of some indigenous NPCs, they may be able to easily rise to the top and be ahead of other players" and so on. Of course, there are also some players who come with the purpose of obtaining information, and among them the most powerful ones are the players.
At this time, Mu Yun actually wanted to tell them: You think too much!
This is the capital of the Han Empire. This is the center of power for the entire empire, and that's right. There is the most and most accurate information here, and that's right. Even the various speculations about Luoyang are basically correct.
But why do these players think that they can access the mission? Can you get an opportunity? Can you contact high-level indigenous NPCs? Can I get the latest information?
Just seeing that most of these players had weird IDs such as "Invincible Little Overlord", "Unparalleled in the World", "One Sword Can Cold Nineteen States", "I am your grandpa", etc., Mu Yun knew that they would never be able to gain favor in front of these aboriginal NPCs, so what opportunities were there? Just a daydream! He is lucky if he can avoid being tricked to death by these aboriginal NPCs!
As for why Mu Yun knows the IDs of these players? Needless to say, he has the eye of truth!
After shaking his head, Mu Yun left.
Game cabins must be purchased by adults over 18 years old, and ordinary parents will not allow children aged four or five to enter the game. Therefore, although several players saw Mu Yun's actions, they all mistakenly regarded Mu Yun as an aboriginal NPC, so no one paid special attention to it.
Since Mu Yun had to deal with those high-level aboriginal NPCs next, he had to take care of his appearance. It happened that Mu Yun was very dissatisfied with the linen outfit that came with it for newbies, so he went to a cloth shop in Luoyang.
People often say: "Buddhas need gold, and people need clothes." Mu Yun deeply agrees.
When Mu Yun walked out of Buzhuang,The rustic little kid from the country disappeared, and was replaced by a... little boy dressed in fine clothes and decorated with pink and jade.
After changing his clothes, Mu Yun started walking towards somewhere in Luoyang City. He looked at the prosperous Luoyang City along the road, but secretly sighed in his heart.
The Han Empire had stood in the "Wang of the Emperor" for more than 400 years, but it also declined for a time. However, relying on the foundation accumulated as an empire, the Han Dynasty resolutely mobilized the destiny of the empire to bring order to the chaos, creating the resurgence of Emperor Guangwu of the Han Dynasty. However, it was precisely because of the excessive consumption of the empire's luck that the aristocratic families of the Han Empire gradually became more foreign-oriented and gradually grew stronger, resulting in a large loss of the empire's luck.
It was just like this that a series of events such as the "Disaster of Party Confinement" would occur later, and the occurrence of these events further caused the empire's destiny to decline. The decline of the empire's destiny led to the continuous occurrence of various natural and man-made disasters. When Emperor Huan and Emperor Ling of the Han Empire realized something was wrong, it was already too late. They began to collect and levy all kinds of things, intending to exchange for cosmic currency to replenish and stabilize their luck. However, they did not know that it was precisely because of their actions that the empire's luck was losing faster.
Two years after the "Emperor's Hope" server is launched, that is, five months later in the real world, the entire "Emperor's Hope" will start its first historical plot mission. It is also the only historical plot mission whose occurrence time can be accurately controlled. After this historical plot mission ends, it all depends on the players' efforts whether and when the historical plots of various countries will be triggered, or whether the entire history will be rewritten in the future.
Of course, Mu Yun, a bug who has mastered the context of "The Only Future", is not included in this list.
At that time, the ancient wild country where the players from the Bear Kingdom are located will usher in the historical plot of "Slave Rebellion", the Violet Empire where the players from the Diao Kingdom are located will usher in the historical plot called "Peasant Uprising", and the Han Empire where the players from the Dragon Kingdom are located will face the historical plot of "Yellow Turban Rebellion".
When the Yellow Turban Rebellion officially started, the destiny of the Han Empire would further accelerate its decline until the empire's destiny collapsed and Emperor Ling of the Han Dynasty was struck back by destiny and died. Since then, the destiny of the Han Empire has been reduced to the destiny of the kingdom. However, how can the destiny of the kingdom afford the imperial-level city of Luoyang? In the end, it was difficult to avoid Dong Zhuo's anger...
On Blue Star, apart from Mu Yun, only the reborn people know this part of the plot, so there are a lot of benefits in it.
Although for Mu Yun, these benefits are not much that can be used, and it takes a lot of time, but there is still the existence of the Mu Group behind him! These things that he doesn't like are not worth the slightest to the Mu Group. Instead of keeping them and being burned by Fatty Dong, it is better to use them as waste. At the very least, the Mu Group's initial investment can be directly repaid.
Soon, Mu Yun had some ideas in his mind. However, these ideas have to be implemented later, and now it is time to get down to business. Mu Yun walked and came to a huge mansion. On the door was written: Zhang Mansion.
We've arrived! Mu Yun narrowed his eyes slightly and thought: "The next time is the time to show off your acting skills."
